title: NPCI UPI · pending or failed payment
section: Customer FAQs · transaction status and safety
content: For a UPI payment that appears pending, the customer can review past and pending payments in the transaction history of their UPI app. If an account was debited for a failed payment and the reversal has not appeared, NPCI advises contacting the customer's bank. Customers can raise or check a UPI transaction grievance through their participating bank's UPI app. Never ask for or share a UPI PIN; bank support will not ask for it. Do not infer the transaction outcome, promise a reversal time, or ask for an OTP or PIN. Source checked for this demo on 2026-10-23; the source page does not state a publication date.
